title: District Commission's Obligation to Refer Matter for Mediation

content.scenario: Raj, a consumer, and a company agreed to settle their dispute through mediation. They gave their consent in writing to the District Commission in Bangalore. The District Commission must refer the matter for mediation within five days of receipt of the consent.
content.outcome: The District Commission shall refer the matter for mediation within five days of receipt of the consent from Raj and the company, and the provisions of Chapter V relating to mediation shall apply, as per the provisions of Section 37(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: Can a consumer dispute be settled through mediation?
What is the procedure for referring a matter for mediation?
What are the provisions applicable to mediation under the Consumer Protection Act?
